🔒 Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 2026

RightPDFKit Privacy Policy

The short version: Your files never leave your device. We don't upload, store, or process your documents on any server. Everything runs in your browser.

1. Who we are

RightPDFKit (rightpdfkit.com) is a free browser-based PDF editor operated by The 36th Company Ltd, London, UK.

2. What data we collect

Files: Zero. Your PDF files are processed entirely within your browser using JavaScript. They are never uploaded to our servers or any third-party server. We have no technical ability to access your files.

Analytics: We use Google Analytics 4 and Plausible Analytics to understand how people use the tool. This includes: pages visited, tools used, country (approximate), device type, and browser. No personally identifiable information is collected. IP addresses are anonymised.

Cookies: We use one cookie — to remember your light/dark theme preference. It is stored only in your browser's localStorage. We do not use advertising cookies or tracking pixels.

3. Third-party services

• Google Analytics 4 — anonymous usage analytics. Google's privacy policy

• Plausible Analytics — privacy-first analytics, no cookies. Plausible's privacy policy

• Tesseract.js — OCR processing, loaded on demand from a CDN. Runs entirely in your browser.

4. Your rights (GDPR)

Since we don't collect personal data from your files, there is nothing to request deletion of. For analytics opt-out, you can use a browser ad-blocker or the Google Analytics opt-out. For questions: azubuikedavies@gmail.com

5. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy occasionally. The date at the top will always reflect the latest version.

Why RightPDFKit vs
iLovePDF, Smallpdf & Adobe?

Every major PDF tool uploads your files to their servers. We built RightPDFKit so that's architecturally impossible — not just a promise in a privacy policy.

🔒
Files never leave your device
Every operation runs in your browser using WebAssembly. Open DevTools → Network while using any tool — you'll see zero requests. The files can't leave because there's no server to send them to.
◎
No limits. No caps. No account.
iLovePDF and Smallpdf cap free users at 25MB and a handful of daily tasks. RightPDFKit has no file size limit, no daily limit, and no sign-up required. Ever.
⚡
Works offline after first load
All libraries are bundled into one file. Load the page once and you can use all 52 tools without any internet connection — on a plane, in a meeting, anywhere.
✦
AI assistant included free
Type "compress this, watermark CONFIDENTIAL, add page numbers" and it does all three. No competitor offers natural language PDF editing — and it still runs locally.

Common questions
What happens to my files?

Nothing leaves your device — ever. All 52 tools run entirely in your browser using WebAssembly. There is no server. There is no upload. Open DevTools Network tab while using the app and you'll see zero file data transmitted.

How do I get my license key?

After checkout via Lemon Squeezy you'll receive a receipt email containing your license key. Paste it in the "Already have a Pro key?" box above and click Activate.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Cancel from your Lemon Squeezy customer portal at any time. No questions, no friction. Your Pro access continues until the end of the billing period.

Does Pro work offline?

Yes. All tools — including Pro tools — work offline once the page has loaded. Your Pro status is stored locally in your browser.

Do I need an account?

No. Not for free tools, and not for Pro. Your license key is your identity. Paste it once, it's stored in your browser. No signup, no password, no email required.

What's the difference vs iLovePDF / Smallpdf?

They upload your files to their servers. RightPDFKit doesn't — your files stay on your device. They charge £9–25/month for the same tools. RightPDFKit Pro is £4.99/month. They show ads on the free tier. RightPDFKit never shows ads.
